necessary_hypotheses_as_written: S is a closed (compact, boundaryless) surface
the symplectic form is analytic; by lines 99-100, on an oriented surface it is a nowhere-vanishing volume form
the conclusion asserts existence of one analytic symplectomorphism f of the surface with its form; f is not required to be near the identity in the statement
no genus restriction in the statement: every genus including 0 and 1
adopted_result_boundary.quantifier_structure_as_written: For every analytic symplectic closed surface, there exists an analytic symplectomorphism f such that (1) f has positive metric entropy and (2) f displays elliptic islands. Existence comes after the universal quantifier: f may depend on the surface and its form.

objects.maps: analytic symplectomorphisms of a closed analytic symplectic surface
objects.regularity: analytic (C^omega) everywhere; the paper does not allow C-infinity-only constructions, which is the stated obstruction at line 144
objects.smooth_counterpart: C-infinity or finite-regularity analogues are not claimed

definitions_used_in_the_statement.term: symplectic form on an oriented surface
definitions_used_in_the_statement.content: nowhere-vanishing volume form; defines a smooth measure Leb
diffeomorphism leaving the form invariant, equivalently orientation preserving and Leb-preserving
mean of Lambda(x) = lim (1/n) log ||D_x f^n||, existing for Leb-a.e. x; positive entropy means exponential sensitivity to initial conditions with positive probability
a domain bounded by a smooth invariant curve on which the dynamics acts as an irrational rotation

normalisation_and_limits: no normalisation of volume or symplectic area is imposed in the statement
no limit or asymptotic regime appears in the statement; positive entropy is strict positivity, not a lower bound
entropy is metric (Kolmogorov-Sinai) entropy, not topological entropy; the constructions use both notions but the statement uses metric entropy

core_recount_boundary.rule_applied: A new candidate is kept only if it carries an independently new advanced core (a genuinely new non-routine construction, estimate or mechanism) above the ordinary doctoral-qualifying level. Lemmas, corollaries and generalisations that are the same mechanism with different parameters, or direct applications of the adopted construction, are not split out.
explicitly_not_split_because_already_cou: analytic symplectic blow-up at a point and at a finite set of hyperbolic periodic orbits (Theorem 2.9, Theorem 2.11)
involution quotient and the analytic/symplectic descent (Theorem 2.3, Corollary 2.4, the Gamma quotient of Section 3.2)
Hamiltonian cap with two elliptic points (Claim 3.2) and its generalized version (Proposition 4.2, Lemma 4.4)
collar gluing of two analytic symplectic surfaces with compatible boundary dynamics (Theorem 2.5)
blow-down of an integrable non-degenerate boundary circle to an elliptic point (Theorem 2.14) and the angle-action lemma 2.15
sphere, torus and pants constructions for all genera (proof 566-580)

results_examined_and_explicitly_judged_n.reason: n=3 application of Claim 3.3, an analytic conjugation to the standard disk form (citing DM90), and the externally quoted Proposition 4.1 of BT19; the robustness clause is delegated, not proved here
glues the annulus dynamics with its inverse (582-601); for pseudo-Anosov classes uses cited analytic representatives plus Proposition 4.2; parameterised reuse of the same cap mechanism
parameterised k-fold repeat of the Section 3.3 pentagon/gluing/blow-down pattern; the author states at 662 that for k=1 the proof 'is basically the same'
short two-case horseshoe argument citing Katok; no advanced new mechanism
internal building blocks of the adopted Theorem A construction

results_that_are_open_or_external.status: open; only routes are suggested at line 139
quoted from BT19; not an author proof of this work

core_recount_boundary.permitted_zero_outcome: Zero new candidates is an explicitly acceptable outcome; none was created.

author_unexpanded_or_open_ranges.content: The author says the Nielsen-Thurston classification 'should lead to' a solution of Problem 1.3 and that Conjecture 1.2 would imply it. No proof is supplied.
States that there is no analytic bump function and that the cited strategies persist only along infinite-codimensional submanifolds; used as motivation for the new approach.

The 'miracle' paragraph: near a saddle point Moser's theorem makes the dynamics the time-one map of an analytic Hamiltonian of the form P+(x,y) mapping to H(x*y), hence analytically liftable to the blow-up. Stated as an idea; the actual statement and proof are Theorem 2.9, with Moser cited as Mo56.
In the proof of Claim 3.3 the case 4 >= n > 1 is said to follow 'by induction on n using the later argument of the inductive step'; that inductive step is not written out in this proof.
author_unexpanded_or_open_ranges.role: author's terse step; not expanded or repaired here

author_unexpanded_or_open_ranges.content: The proof of Lemma 4.4 opens with 'For k=1, this lemma implies Claim 3.2; its proof is basically the same' and then gives the general-k argument in outline with a figure.
author_unexpanded_or_open_ranges.role: author's compression; recorded, not filled in

author_unexpanded_or_open_ranges.content: Announces that in Section 4.2 'the normal form at the saddle points is more general' and that the work is done on a 2-lifting; detail is delegated to the cited Moser normal form and to Lemma 4.4.

normal_conventions_or_scope_boundaries_n.advice_zh: S31/S42用途指引正常，不进缺口或索取清单。
Anosov矩阵及正交特征坐标是正常设定，没有作者承诺计算却省略的义务；矩阵所在实际行是408，409是固定点集合。没有重算lambda。
theta加pi和商后角周期pi是该involution的正常坐标转换；高度上界只沿第1项保留，不另报一项缺陷。
从hyperbolic lifting取得正熵是旧2155构造的一部分，未显示数值熵计算不构成新作者省略；不重审也不追加估计。
Hamiltonian、正负能级及进出截面的定义承担旧cap定位，不因定义形式不同就作为缺口。
arcsin区间与流的法向分量文字是作者明确写出的计算内容；可以保留原式供读者查阅，但不由该观察新增证明缺口。本review没有认证其符号/方向或自行校正。
643明确说明cP由唯一周期轨道组成，所以Lambda不依赖P；640省去P是已说明的正常约化，不是未解释的参数丢失。
同一图两个label，未使用的fig:oldcoord不造成数学缺口，无需索取作者补证。
sqrt(2r)与高度delta²/2是正常极坐标/作用量变量对应，不把其当作独立不一致；上界后续字面差异仅第1项处理。
Theorem A不指定isotopy class，Corollary C才给特定类；这是应保留的结论范围差别，不是作者缺陷。
